notes: Fictional object in TBox (retagged from relation in review): a real class (German nouns in '-ung') and the real notion of a stem type (has_stem_type), with a made-up value, 'brightstemmed'. Only one part is made up, so this is not relation plus object. Modern German grammar assigns '-ung' nouns no stem class (stem classes such as the ō-stems belong to older Germanic), so no real value is overwritten. Well-known members (Wohnung, Zeitung, Hoffnung) are determinate because nothing stored about them concerns a made-up value (criteria: a TBox object insert may be all determinate); Q4 names a new member. Q3 chains a second made-up rule stated in the prompt. Near query asks the real gender of '-ung' nouns (feminine), which differs from the new answer. It says 'formed with the suffix -ung' because a few nouns that merely end in '-ung' are masculine (der Sprung, der Schwung).
